checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Body is a clear navy/royal blue; slightly bright but reads as navy.

must.item: Car retains shape, windows, tyres, trim, lights
must.why: Geometry, wheels, tail light, plate all match.

must.item: Shading and reflections consistent with sunny lighting
